- Overall performance: The company's revenue after eliminations is INR 668.59 billion with a gross margin of 54.9% and EBITDA margin of 38.7%.
- The company that contributes the most to revenue is Wipro Consumer Care International with INR 264.91 billion, while the one that needs attention is Wipro Consumer Care India with an EBITDA margin of 18.2%, the lowest among all companies.
- Margins are 54.9% for gross margin and 38.7% for EBITDA margin.
- Working capital as of 2026-07-01 is indicated by DSO of 123 days and DPO of 300 days.
- The top 3 revenue drivers are: everything excluding business Joint Ventures with a revenue change of INR 62.01 billion (85.2% of total change), SAP product sales with a revenue change of INR 57.64 billion (79.2% of total change), and business Joint Ventures with a revenue change of INR 10.76 billion (14.8% of total change).
